Official Policy Document

Privacy Policy for Calesthetics

Effective Date: October 19, 2026  |  Last Updated: October 19, 2026

Application: Calesthetics  |  Publisher: Verado Studio

🔒 Our Core Privacy Principle

We do NOT sell, rent, monetize, or share your personal information, training history, or subscription records with third-party advertisers, data brokers, or marketing networks. Your answers and progress are used only to build your plan, keep your progress, and let it follow you to a new phone if you create an account. Without an account, everything stays on your phone.

1. Information We Collect and Purpose of Collection

Calesthetics collects only the information needed to build your training plan, track your progress, and run your subscription. If you use the app as a guest, none of it leaves your phone.

A. Training Profile & Preferences

  • What We Collect: Your answers while setting up your plan: goal, age range, where you train, equipment, experience, days per week, session length, preferred time of day, focus areas, your plank test result, and the first name you type in. You may also choose "areas to protect" (for example knees or wrists); this is optional.
  • Why We Collect It: To choose and build your plan and to avoid exercises that load an area you asked us to protect. The plan is built by fixed rules from your answers; there is no profiling and no automated decision with legal effect.
  • Health-related answers: Areas to protect are your own preference. They are not a medical record, and we do not diagnose or assess anything.

B. Workouts & Progress

  • What We Collect: Workouts you finish or add by hand (name, date, length, exercises), how far you got in a workout you left early, how a set felt (Easy / Just right / Hard), favorites, personal records, plank results, and app settings such as your reminder time, theme and music choice.
  • Why We Collect It: To show your streak, achievements, calendar and history, to let you resume a workout, and to set your reminders.

C. Account & Authentication (Optional)

  • What We Collect: If you create an account: your email address, the display name you give, and how you sign in (email and password, Google, or Apple). With Apple you may hide your email; we then receive Apple's private relay address. Your password is handled by Firebase Authentication; we never see it.
  • Why We Collect It: To secure your account and to save your plan and progress so they come back when you sign in on another phone.

D. Subscriptions, In-App Purchases & Billing

  • Apple App Store & Google Play Billing: When you buy Premium, the payment is processed by Apple or Google. Calesthetics does not collect, store, or have access to your card number, bank details, or billing address.
  • Subscription Infrastructure (RevenueCat): We use RevenueCat to check and manage subscriptions. It receives purchase receipts, purchase and renewal dates, your subscription status, and an app user ID (your account ID, or an anonymous one for a guest), only to confirm what you have bought and unlock Premium on your devices.

E. Technical Data

  • Like any app that uses the internet, the services below see your IP address and basic device and request information when the app talks to them: Google (Firebase) when you sign in or sync, and our media provider Bunny.net when exercise videos and pictures load.
  • We do not use advertising IDs, analytics or crash-reporting tools, and we do not track you across other apps or websites.

2. Strict Zero Third-Party Sharing Policy

We keep a strict standard:

  • No Data Monetization: We do not sell, rent, license, or barter your personal information or training data, ever.
  • No Advertising Trackers: We do not include third-party advertising SDKs, cross-app tracking libraries, or marketing pixels.
  • No AI Processing of Your Data: We do not send anything you enter or do in the app to an AI service. The exercise videos and pictures were made in advance with AI tools (Google Flow) and ship as fixed content.
  • Trusted Service Providers: We use these providers only to run the app, each acting on our instructions: Google (Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore and Google Sign-In: accounts and your synced data), Apple (Sign in with Apple and the App Store), Google Play (billing on Android), RevenueCat (subscription status), and Bunny.net (delivery of exercise videos and pictures). They may not use your data for anything else.
  • Legal and Safety: We may disclose information if the law requires it, or to protect the app and its users from fraud or abuse. If Verado Studio is ever sold or merged, this policy keeps applying to your data.

3. How Your Data Is Stored: Guest or Account

  • Guest: Your plan, progress and settings are stored only on your phone. Nothing is uploaded. Deleting the app, clearing its data, or using Profile > Erase data on this phone erases them.
  • Account: Your data is saved in one private record that belongs to your account (Google Cloud Firestore), protected by security rules so that only you, signed in, can read or change it. Changes sync a few seconds after you make them.
  • Creating an account keeps what you already did as a guest. Signing in to an existing account shows that account's own data on the phone instead.
  • Signing out removes your data from the phone. It stays in your account, ready for your next sign-in.

4. Device Permissions & Data Access

Calesthetics asks only for what its features need:

  • Notifications: Used only for the workout reminders you switch on. They are scheduled on your phone itself; there is no push-notification server, and you can turn them off anytime in the app or in system settings.
  • Vibration: Used for the light haptic feedback while you use the app. It needs no data.
  • Share sheet: When you tap Share on an achievement, the app hands a picture of that achievement card and one line of text to your phone's share sheet. Nothing is sent unless you choose where to share it.
  • Not requested: camera, photo library, microphone, location, contacts, or health data (such as Apple Health or Google Fit).

5. User Rights, Data Control & Account Deletion

In line with Apple App Store Review Guideline 5.1.1, the Google Play User Data policy, and privacy laws such as the GDPR and the CCPA/CPRA, you stay in control:

  • In the app: You can change your name, switch reminders off, sign out, or delete your account yourself.
  • Complete Account Erasure: You can permanently erase your account and everything saved in it, directly in the app:
Profile > Delete Account

When you confirm, your account record is deleted from our servers, your sign-in account is deleted, and the data is cleared from your phone. If your last sign-in was a while ago, you may first be asked to confirm that it is you (with Google, Apple or your password). On iPhone, the app's Sign in with Apple access is also revoked.

Without an account (guest): nothing is stored on our servers, so there is no account to delete. To clear what is saved on your phone (plan, history, favorites and settings), use Profile > Erase data on this phone. If you bought Premium on that phone, use Restore purchases afterwards to get it back.

  • Subscription Cancellation Reminder: Deleting your account does not cancel an active Apple or Google subscription. Cancel it in your Apple ID or Google Play subscription settings.
  • Your rights: Depending on where you live (for example the EU, the UK, or California) you may ask us for access to your data, to correct it, to delete it, to receive a copy (portability), to restrict or object to its use, and to complain to your data-protection authority. We do not sell or share your data for advertising, and we do not treat you differently for using these rights.
  • How to ask: Email support@veradostudio.com. We reply to privacy requests within 30 days.
  • Legal bases (GDPR): We use your data to provide the app you asked for (contract), to keep it secure (legitimate interest), and, for optional things like reminders, with your consent, which you can withdraw anytime.

6. Security & Data Retention

All communication between the app and our servers is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS). Account data is stored with Google Cloud, which encrypts it at rest, behind security rules that let only the signed-in owner read or change their own record. No system is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your data.

We keep your data only as long as your account exists. When you delete it, your record is removed from our servers right away; copies in the provider's backups are overwritten on their normal schedule. Guest data stays on your phone until you delete the app or clear its data. Emails you send to support are kept only as long as needed to help you.

7. Mandatory Non-Medical Disclaimer

⚠️ Training Guidance — Not Medical Advice

Calesthetics is a fitness and training app. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical diagnoses, treatment or clinical advice. The "areas to protect" you choose only change which exercises are suggested; they are not a medical assessment. Talk to a doctor before you start if you have an injury, a health condition, or are pregnant, and stop right away if anything hurts.

8. Children's Privacy

Calesthetics is intended for adults aged 18 and over and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 13 (or under 16 in the European Union). If you believe a child has given us information, contact us and we will delete it promptly.

9. International Data Transfers

Our providers (Google, RevenueCat, Bunny.net, Apple) run servers in several countries, including outside your own, such as the United States and the European Union. By using an account you understand that your data may be processed there, under the safeguards those providers offer, such as standard contractual clauses.

10. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy when the app, its features or the law change. The new version is posted here with an updated "Last Updated" date, and the in-app copy is updated with it. Continuing to use Calesthetics after a change means you accept the updated policy. See also our Terms of Service.
